capabilities: Create and maintain same-name navigator pages for each folder
Generate and update Home.md for top-level folders and notes
Sort underscore-prefixed files last and optionally pin navigator pages in the file explorer
Route new notes created from wiki links into a _node subfolder
Exclude folders, files, names, or extensions by rules and clean orphan navigator pages
disambiguation: Not a navigation pane or file explorer replacement; it generates and maintains Markdown index pages inside each folder.
extras: Localization is automatic: UI text switches between Chinese and English based on Obsidian's language. The README notes that file explorer pinning and sorting use internal interfaces and may need compatibility updates across Obsidian versions, and that workspace snapshots only restore tabs and layout from the previous session.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to give every folder an auto-maintained index page linking to its child folders and notes, so folder-based users must write and update these by hand.
summary: Folder navigation generator that creates and maintains same-name overview pages for each folder plus a Home.md, with sorting, pinning, and orphan cleanup.
